newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa to privatise 100 percent of Aventura.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa to privatise 100 percent of Aventura.

text.p: The South African government annnounced on Friday it would privatise its entire stake in state-run leisure group Aventura.
It said that both labour and government had recently agreed to the 100 percent disposal of equity in Aventura.

The government had also mandated its adviser -- Hong Kong Shanghai Bank Corp (HSBC) -- to work with the Development Bank of Southern Africa (DBSA) and the Industrial Development Corporation (IDC) to steer the Aventura privatisation process.
"This therefore removes the need to hire a private adviser for the transaction," the Public Enterprises Ministry said in a statement.
The three organisations were currently involved in the valuation of Aventura Properties in preparation for the imminent start of the bidding process.
